import json

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

                if grid[r][c] == v:
                    left = c

                    right = c

                    top = r
                    while top > 0 and grid[top-1][c] != bg and grid[top-1][c] == grid[r][c]:
                        top -= 1
                    bottom = r
                    while bottom < h-1 and grid[bottom+1][c] != bg and grid[bottom+1][c] == grid[r][c]:
                        bottom += 1
                    
                    if (top < bottom and left < right - 1):
                        frames.append((top, left, bottom, right, v))
    
    unique_frames = []
    for t, l, b, r, v in frames:
        merged = False
        for i, (ut, ul, ub, ur, uv) in enumerate(unique_frames):
